content: {"summary": "Tesla began reporting revenue under two XBRL concepts in 2018 because it adopted the ASC 606 revenue‑recognition standard, which required parallel tagging of the legacy ‘Revenues’ concept and the new ‘RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax’ concept. For fiscal years 2011‑2017 only the ‘Revenues’ concept was used, so that concept should be relied on for those years. Starting in 2018 the two concepts contain identical values, so either can be used, though the ASC 606‑aligned concept is preferable for consistency with current GAAP."}
